title: intel.config.changed v1 payload
description: A ranking config version of one surface was created, activated or rolled back (feed, Tara Intelligence WP 4.1). Emitted in the transaction that writes the intel_ranking_config_change row. The actor is the envelope's actor_id (null: the system). Ids, enums and numbers only: the free-text reason stays in feed's change log, the payload says only whether one was given. subject_id is '<surface>@<to_version>'. Behind INTEL_EMIT_CONFIG_CHANGED (default on). Consumer: admin (AuditEntry).
